Add a new provider class for ElectronHub API integration, supporting an extensive collection of 371 AI models including:

- Mistral models (all sizes from tiny to large)
- Various Chinese models (GLM, Yi, Qwen, etc.)
- Image generation models (SDXL, Stable Diffusion, etc.)
- Video generation models
- Audio and embedding models

The implementation includes:
- Streaming and non-streaming chat capabilities
- Temperature and sampling parameters control
- Complete conversation history management
- LitAgent user-agent integration for API access

This expands Webscout's model selection significantly with minimal API configuration needed.
